description: Content: expandable FAQ component + last-updated footer date. Edits craco.config.js (minimal define block) and Footer.jsx only. Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 except it runs last in order. No index.css changes.
steps: #17 Expandable FAQ: Create frontend/src/components/FAQ.jsx. Props: items: [{question, answer}]. Use native <details>/<summary> for robust keyboard accessibility (or button + aria-expanded). Animate open/close respecting prefers-reduced-motion (e.g. a max-height/opacity transition that becomes instant under reduced-motion). Export the component for reuse. Commit: feat: add expandable FAQ (#17).

#16 Last updated: In frontend/craco.config.js add a webpack.define (or EnvironmentPlugin) block injecting REACT_APP_BUILD_DATE = JSON.stringify(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]) — keep the edit minimal (only the define section, leave the existing alias + jest config intact). In frontend/src/components/Footer.jsx replace the two hardcoded '2026' occurrences ('Made with wanderlust — 2026' and '© 2026 Chalo Ghumne...') with {new Date().getFullYear()} and add an 'Updated {process.env.REACT_APP_BUILD_DATE || new Date().getFullYear()}' line in the footer. Commit: feat: add last updated date (#16).
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes with no errors and REACT_APP_BUILD_DATE is defined at build time
Footer shows the current year dynamically and an 'Updated <date>' line
FAQ component renders items as keyboard-operable accordions
verification: cd frontend && npm run build  (must succeed, 0 errors)
Manually: footer bottom shows current year + 'Updated YYYY-MM-DD'; FAQ items expand/collapse with Enter/Space and keyboard focus is visible
